 Hon'Ble Shekhar B. Saraf, J. 
Hon'Ble Swarupama Chaturvedi, J.
1.
We have heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the parties.2.

Petitioner is directed to file appeal under the Food Safety and Standards Act within ten days and if the said appeal is filed within the aforesaid time, the authority concerned should grant opportunity of hearing and thereafter, pass a reasoned order in accordance with law within a period of three weeks from the date of receipt of the application.
3. With the above direction, the petition is disposed of.

(Swarupama Chaturvedi,J.) (Shekhar B. Saraf,J.) November 6, 2025 S.A.
